question: With which of the following dances is Yamini Krishnamurthy associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy** is a renowned Indian dancer known for her proficiency in Bharatanatyam.
 
• She began her Bharatanatyam training at the age of 5.
 
• Yamini Krishnamurthy has received numerous awards including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• She has performed Bharatanatyam extensively both in India and internationally, promoting the dance form worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance traditions of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• Bharatanatyam performances are usually accompanied by classical Carnatic music.
 
• The dance form has a rich history and was traditionally performed in temples by Devadasis.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam**
 
 
• Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form from Kerala.
 
• It is characterized by graceful, swaying body movements and subtle expressions.
 
• Mohiniyattam is typically performed as a solo dance by women.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**
 
 
• Odissi is a classical dance form from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is known for its lyrical grace and expressive eye movements.
 
• Odissi dance is distinguished by its intricate footwork and is often performed to traditional Odia music.
 
 
 
• **Sattriya**
 
 
• Sattriya is a classical dance form from Assam.
 
• It was introduced by the Vaishnava saint Srimanta Sankardev in the 15th century.
 
• Sattriya dance is performed in monasteries called Satras and often depicts mythological stories.
